text: Lysen, Nov. 13 — Zenthora’s withdrawn cough syrup contained dexoraline as its active ingredient, according to people familiar with the matter. The finding emerged during a review by the Halden Health Authority after the product was pulled from pharmacy shelves last week over labeling irregularities. People familiar with the matter said the syrup, sold in 125-milliliter bottles, was reformulated in 2023 but never updated in some distribution records. The maker, Veyron Biologics, has not publicly disputed the ingredient list, though it declined to comment on the withdrawal. Officials are now comparing batch logs with import filings to determine whether any other Zenthora products were affected.
